title: 第三章 纠结的任务
slug: 网游之剑刃舞者全本免费-网游之剑刃舞者最新章节列表
content_zh:
玉米地在野兔坡的另一侧，与绿树林接壤，怪的级数是8-14级。林铮来到玉米地，一眼望去，玉米的长势喜人啊，一棵上边能结好几个玉米棒子，怎么看都不科学，那个头还贼大，看着都挺有食欲的！不过这玉米大丰收也引来了许多不速之客。
大乌鸦：8级物理攻击65-174,物理防御55气血500偷吃谷物的盗贼，成群结伙，经常让村民们颗粒无收
林铮现在是6级，每升一级有5点属性，他按3力2体地加，所以现在物理攻击是68-141防御有60，气血有600，怎么看都比这只8级的乌鸦强多了，打这些乌鸦应该是没有压力的。
看到有几个等级已经7级的玩家在这里杀着乌鸦，不过看样子杀得挺纠结的！鸟禽类怪物的动作都比较敏捷，谁叫他们会飞啊！优势太明显了。大乌鸦飞身撞过来，这要是操作不怎么好的玩家，十有八九要被打到，而且你还要在它打到你之前攻击到它，这就更考验玩家的预判操作了。至少林铮看到的这几个玩家的操作都不怎么好，好不容易打死一只乌鸦了，自己的血都掉了一大半，超级不划算啊！
“艹！打这乌鸦太不划算了，兄弟们换地方！”一个彪悍的战士骂骂咧咧地说到，几个同伴也很同意地点着头，于是乎就这么走了一个小分队的人了。
林铮倒没什么感觉，这乌鸦动作虽然很快，不过比起现实的乌鸦可要慢了不少，总归是游戏的怪，真飞得和现实一样快有几个能打得着啊！就现在这点动作速度，对林铮还是没什么难度的。嗯，试试看就知道了。林铮对着一只大乌鸦，匕首一下就甩了出去，-96，“呱呱！”被打中的大乌鸦一下就朝林铮飞扑而来，这时拿到匕首的林铮又是一下扔了出去，-94！被击中的大乌鸦攻击动作被终止，停在了当空，这会儿动作就要快了，林铮箭步上前，挥起匕首一划，-82，-75，乌鸦反击的爪子一抓林铮，-65，没事儿！挥起匕首再来一下，-78，乌鸦叫了一下就掉地上了，还欠着些血呢。没难度，接着杀，林铮握紧匕首，朝下一只乌鸦走去。
打完七八只乌鸦林铮便会停下来打坐一会儿，血都掉差不多了，打坐可以加快气血回复。差不多10秒，气血恢复满了，林铮再次拿起匕首杀向乌鸦们。很快的，一个下午过去了，期间来玉米地练级的人来了一拨又一拨，不过最后又骂骂咧咧地走了一拨又一拨，只有林铮和零星几个操作不错的玩家还在玉米地杀着乌鸦。乌鸦的经验不错，林铮已经8级了，不过一直没有把眼镜掉出来，这让林铮十分纠结！这个鬼任务，不会等到他10级了还完成不了吧？想想都叫林铮气闷。
唔，8点了，下线去吃点东西再来奋斗吧！于是林铮子，来到厨房，发现杨琪已经在了，正很不耐烦地等着炉子上的水开。
“烧得多不，我也泡碗面吃！”
“嘿——！你来得也太是时候了！”这时，水壶“呜呜——”的响了起来提醒着二人这水烧开了。杨琪关掉火，边往自己的泡面加水边道：“不多也不少，少点汤将就着吃就是了！”
“无所谓，汤太多也喝不完！”
“……”
一人端着一碗泡面回到客厅，吃得有滋有味的，中间杨琪问道：“玩得怎么样了林铮？几级了？要姐去带你不！”那一脸得意样看得林铮想上去给她一拳，如果她是男人的话。你说你一个职业的和一个业余的比有意思吗？有意思吗？嗯，不用说也知道，杨琪一定觉得很有意思很有成就感！
“我现在8级，在做一个任务，做得我头都大了！”林铮很是郁闷地说到。杨琪听了倒是一愣，“8级了啊！小样儿升级还挺快，我也才9级，还差点才到10级，不错嘛你小子！”
“嗯，你做什么任务让你头疼？”
“给村长找眼镜，喵了个咪的！打了一个下午的乌鸦居然愣是没掉，我都怀疑一转前有没有希望完成！”说罢，林铮狠狠地吃了一大口泡面，似乎想把一下午的郁闷都吃进去消化掉似的。杨琪听完，一脸的不感兴趣。

content_en:
The cornfield is on the other side of the hare slope, bordering the green woods. The level of monsters is 8-14. Lin Zheng came to the corn field and took a quick look. The corn was growing gratifyingly. There were several corn cobs on one tree. It was unscientific no matter how you looked at it. The head was so big that it looked quite appetizing! However, this corn harvest also attracted many uninvited guests.
Big Crow: Level 8 physical attack 65-174, physical defense 55 HP 500. Thieves who steal grains and gang up in groups, often leaving villagers with no harvest.
Lin Zheng is now level 6, with 5 attribute points for each level. He adds 3 power and 2 body, so now the physical attack is 68-141, the defense is 60, and the health is 600. It is much stronger than this level 8 crow. There should be no pressure to fight these crows.
I saw several players who were already at level 7 killing crows here, but they seemed to be quite confused about killing them! Birds and monsters are relatively agile in their movements. Who told them they could fly? The advantages are too obvious. The big crow flies towards you. If the player is not very good at this, he will most likely be hit. Moreover, you have to attack it before it hits you. This will test the player's prediction operation even more. At least the operations of the players Lin Zheng saw were not very good. They finally killed a crow and lost more than half of their blood. It was super uneconomical!
"Fuck! It's not cost-effective to fight this crow, brothers, change places!" A tough soldier cursed, and several companions nodded in agreement, so a small team of people left.
Lin Zheng didn't feel anything at all. Although this crow moves very fast, it is much slower than real crows. It is a monster in the game after all. How many can fly as fast as real crows can beat it? At this speed of movement, it is not difficult for Lin Zheng. Well, you'll find out after you try it. Lin Zheng faced a big crow and threw the dagger out, -96, "Quack!" The big crow that was hit flew toward Lin Zheng. At this time, Lin Zheng, who got the dagger, threw it out again, -94! The attack of the big crow that was hit was terminated and stopped in the air. At this moment, the action was about to be faster. Lin Zheng stepped forward, waved the dagger and slashed, -82, -75. The crow's counterattack claw grabbed Lin Zheng, -65, it's okay! He waved the dagger and struck again, -78. The crow crowed and fell to the ground, still needing some blood. It's not difficult, just keep killing. Lin Zheng clenched his dagger and walked towards the next crow.
After beating seven or eight crows, Lin Zheng would stop and meditate for a while. The blood would almost have been lost. Meditation can speed up the recovery of qi and blood. After almost 10 seconds, his energy and blood were fully restored, and Lin Zheng picked up the dagger again and killed the crows. Soon, an afternoon passed. During this period, groups of people who came to the cornfield for leveling came one after another, but in the end they left again and again, cursing. Only Lin Zheng and a few players with good skills were still killing crows in the cornfield. Crow's experience is good, Lin Zheng is already level 8, but his glasses have never fallen out, which makes Lin Zheng very confused! This ghost mission won't be completed until he reaches level 10, right? Just thinking about it makes Lin Zheng feel depressed.
Well, it's 8 o'clock, go offline and have something to eat before fighting again! So Lin Zhengzi came to the kitchen and found that Yang Qi was already there, waiting impatiently for the water to boil on the stove.
"If it's too hot, I'll make a bowl of noodles!"
"Hey——! You came at the perfect time!" At this time, the kettle buzzed to remind them that the water was boiling. Yang Qi turned off the heat, added water to her instant noodles and said, "No more, no less, just a little less soup and eat it!"
"It doesn't matter, there's too much soup and I can't finish it!"
"..."
One person returned to the living room with a bowl of instant noodles and ate it deliciously. In the middle, Yang Qi asked: "How was it?Lin Zheng? What level is it? Do you want my sister to take you? "The smug look on Lin Zheng's face made Lin Zheng want to go up and punch her, if she were a man. Do you think it's interesting to compare a professional with an amateur? Is it interesting? Well, it goes without saying that Yang Qi must find it interesting and fulfilling!
"I am currently at level 8 and doing a task, which makes my head spin! Lin Zheng said very depressedly. Yang Qi was stunned after hearing this, "It's level 8!" The demo upgrades quite quickly. I'm only at level 9, and I'm still close to level 10. That's good, kid! "
“Well, what task gives you a headache? "
"I'm looking for glasses for the village chief. I'm so happy!" The crow I've been playing for all afternoon actually didn't drop. I doubted whether there was any hope of completing it before the turn! "After that, Lin Zheng took a big mouthful of instant noodles, as if he wanted to eat all the depression in the afternoon. After Yang Qi listened, he looked uninterested.
